failureMessage: an import past claudinite-tasks' published public/ couples a consumer to a layout the pack is free to change
fix: import it from packs/claudinite-tasks/public/, adding the named export there if it is not published yet; a canon pack's own test may reach src/ for a test-only name

matchLines.what: reads claudinite-tasks past its published surface: "{match}"
matchLines.fix: reach it through packs/claudinite-tasks/public/, adding the named export there if it is not published yet

failureMessage: the Actions GITHUB_TOKEN is refused on the REST variables API in every member, so the read never answers and costs a call and a log line per run
fix: read the variable from the executor's vars bag (packs/claudinite-tasks/src/world/vars-bag.mjs): a task's code-work finds every repository variable already in process.env, and engine code reads varsBag(env)

matchLines.what: reads a repository variable over the REST API: "{match}"
matchLines.fix: take it from the vars bag — CLAUDINITE_VARS, unpacked into a task's environment by taskEnv and readable in engine code through varsBag(env)
